posters.title: Mobile Authentication & Login UI
posters.description: Design a modern and user-friendly authentication experience for a mobile application, including welcome, sign-in, and account access screens. Focus on simplicity, accessibility, and intuitive user interactions.
objectives: Task 1: Design an engaging welcome screen with clear sign-in and registration options.
Task 2: Create a secure and intuitive login interface with email, password, and social sign-in methods.
Task 3: Maintain a consistent visual style and responsive mobile user experience throughout the authentication flow.
posters.author: Easy

posters.title: Customer Reviews & Appointment Booking UI
posters.description: Design a seamless appointment booking and customer review experience for a mobile application. The interface enables users to schedule appointments, browse customer feedback, filter reviews by ratings, and sort reviews to make informed decisions
objectives: Task 1: Design an intuitive appointment scheduling interface with date and time selection.
Task 2: Create a customer reviews page with ratings, reviewer details, and feedback.
Task 3: Implement review filtering and sorting options to improve user experience.
posters.author: Easy

posters.title: Travel Booking Mobile App UI
posters.description: Design a modern travel booking mobile application featuring a branded splash screen, user authentication, profile management, and notification settings. Focus on creating a clean, intuitive, and engaging user experience for travelers.
objectives: Task 1: Design a visually appealing splash screen and user authentication flow.
Task 2: Create a user profile interface with account management and navigation options.
Task 3: Design a customizable notification settings screen for travel updates and promotions.
posters.author: Easy

posters.title: Cryptocurrency Portfolio & Trading App UI
posters.description: Design a modern cryptocurrency trading and portfolio management application that enables users to monitor investments, explore market trends, manage digital assets, review transaction history, and securely trade cryptocurrencies through an intuitive mobile interface.
objectives: Task 1: Design secure authentication, onboarding, and account setup screens for a cryptocurrency trading application.
Task 2: Create portfolio dashboards, live market tracking, asset search, and investment management interfaces.
Task 3: Build trading workflows including buy/sell operations, transaction history, security settings, and user profile management.
posters.author: Intermediate

posters.title: Online Grocery Shopping Mobile App UI
posters.description: Design a modern online grocery shopping application that enables users to browse products, manage shopping carts, complete secure checkout, track orders, and enjoy a smooth mobile shopping experience with an intuitive and visually appealing interface.
objectives: Task 1: Design user authentication, onboarding, splash screen, and delivery location setup.
Task 2: Create grocery browsing, product details, favorites, shopping cart, and checkout screens.
Task 3: Build order confirmation, OTP verification, user profile, and order management interfaces for a seamless shopping experience.
posters.author: Intermediate

posters.title: Fashion E-Commerce Mobile App UI
posters.description: Design a modern fashion e-commerce mobile application that enables users to browse clothing collections, manage wishlists, add products to the cart, complete secure payments, and track orders through a clean, intuitive, and engaging shopping experience.
objectives: Task 1: Design authentication screens including onboarding, login, sign up, password recovery, and OTP verification.
Task 2: Create shopping experiences including product listings, product details, wishlist, reviews, shopping cart, and order summary.
Task 3: Design user profile, address management, payment methods, navigation menu, and order confirmation screens while maintaining a consistent user interface.
posters.author: Intermediate

posters.title: Doctor Listing Mobile App UI
posters.description: Design a modern healthcare mobile application that helps users search for doctors, book appointments, view hospital information, receive notifications, and manage their healthcare journey with a clean and user-friendly interface.
objectives: Task 1: Design onboarding, login, registration, and account management screens with a simple and secure user experience.
Task 2: Create healthcare browsing screens including home, doctor listing, doctor search, hospital details, news, and notifications.
Task 3: Design online consultation, appointment booking, and user profile management screens while maintaining a clean, modern, and consistent mobile UI.
posters.author: Advanced
